reuse.why: Reuses extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag, setBudget/batchMessages/getSheetValue and the undoable mutator registration; the saved-template check is a fresh JSON parse rather than anything shared, but no direct helper for it existed.

duplication.why: It folds the three copied category queries into getFillableCategories, but copyPreviousMonth re-states the exclusion rules inline on getBudgetData rows, and the income/tracking check stays copied in every loop.

placement.why: Selection rules live in actions.ts beside the actions and the new method is registered in app.ts as the others are; the hidden rule is split between an SQL fragment and an inline TS condition.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; three release notes are expected; it also changes setZero to now skip hidden categories, as step 1 requires.

maintainability.why: A new exclusion must be added in two places (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth's condition), and the includeHidden flag is threaded through each action and both paths separately.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth applies hidden/template/#fixed exclusions on getBudgetData rows instead of using getFillableCategories

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's combined condition (includeHidden && hidden/group_hidden || hasSavedTemplates || isFixedGroup) restates getFillableCategories' SQL WHERE plus filter in a different shape; the income/tracking guard is repeated per action loop.

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories gained includeHiddenCategories (with a conditional SQL fragment); copyPreviousMonth bypasses it with its own inline exclusion condition and its own includeHidden branch.
